function.name: calculate_electric_current
function.description: Calculate the electric current through a conductor given voltage and resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

voltage.description: The voltage across the conductor in Volts. This is a float type value.

resistance.description: The resistance of the conductor in Ohms. This is a float type value.

conductance.description: The conductance of the conductor in Siemens. Optional if resistance is provided. Default: 0.3 This is a float type value.

message.content:
電力（電現象）並不是由單一人「發現」的，而是經過多位科學家逐步揭示與利用的結果。以下是幾個關鍵人物與里程碑：

| 時期 | 科學家 | 主要貢獻 |
|------|--------|----------|
| 古希臘 | 赫拉克利特、德摩斯梯尼 | 觀察到靜電（摩擦產生的帶電現象） |
| 1600 年代 | 威廉·吉爾伯特（William Gilbert） | 首次系統研究靜電與磁性，提出「electricus」一詞，奠定電學基礎 |
| 1752 年 | 本傑明·富蘭克林（Benjamin Franklin） | 以風箏實驗證明雷電是電流，提出正負電荷概念 |
| 1800 年代 | 阿萊桑德羅·伏打（Alessandro Volta） | 發明伏打電池，提供持續電流來源 |
| 1831 年 | 麥可·法拉第（Michael Faraday） | 發現電磁感應，開啟電動機與發電機的發展 |
| 1879 年 | 托馬斯·愛迪生（Thomas Edison） | 發明燈泡並建立電力供應系統 |

簡而言之，電力的「發現」是一個累積的歷史過程，從古代對靜電的觀察，到近代科學家對電荷、電流、磁場等概念的系統化研究，才最終把電力變成可被利用的能源。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "誰發現了電力？" meaning "Who discovered electricity?" They want an answer. We can answer: Electricity was known since ancient times, but the discovery of electricity as a phenomenon was by many. The question likely expects a historical answer: The ancient Greeks observed static electricity; William Gilbert coined the term "electricus" in 1600; Benjamin Franklin's experiments in 1752; etc. So answer: It was discovered by many, but key figures: William Gilbert, Benjamin Franklin, Alessandro Volta, etc. Provide a concise answer.
